title: New packings: s(266) ≤ 16.82302875075648, s(270) ≤ 16.93780722844603, s(272) ≤ 16.96811014576960
body:
Following `packing/frontier/README.md#adding-or-reviewing-a-result`.

**Claim.** Three new packings, each below the register's current bound (checked 6 October, 20:30 MDT):

| n | new bound S' (rational, certificate) | register | difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| 266 | 16.823028750756475970708783711254 | 16.82306208283781 (Ellsworth 2024; exact optimum 5 Oct) | −3.33e-5 |
| 270 | 16.937807228446029110709567408515 | 16.9378103293409541102 (Couzo 27 Sep; exact optimum 5 Oct) | −3.10e-6 |
| 272 | 16.968110145769600505005359235592 | 16.968165867852158 (Couzo 3 Oct; exact optimum 5 Oct) | −5.57e-5 |

These are new packings, not re-optimisations of the register's: each is a different local minimum near the previous record
(RMS matching distance per square from the register packing, corner-displacement units, best of the 8 container
symmetries: 266: 0.032, 270: 0.032, 272: 0.042).

**How they were found.** Perturb a known packing (Gaussian on every coordinate, σ = 0.01–0.03, angles 20σ degrees), then a
soft penalty squeeze and a sequential-LP descent to a first-order jammed state.  266 and 270 came from perturbing the register
record during a sweep over the open non-integer n = 30–323; 272 came from perturbing an *older* 272 packing (16.96971602, the best known on 30 September
before Casson's and Couzo's; distance 0.024 to the new one); 266 improved a second time from a deeper search around the first find.

**Certificate.** `s12/search/exact/results/sw2/` in https://github.com/evand/square-packing (commit [7eef24f](https://github.com/evand/square-packing/tree/7eef24f/s12/search/exact/results/sw2)):
`dc1_n266.cert`, `sw2_n270.cert`, `rd1_n272.cert`.  Same format as #375 (rational centres, rational t = tan(θ/2), open box
of rational side S').  `*.exact.txt` are the 80-digit KKT points; `inputs/{dc1_n266,sw2_n270,rd1_n272}.txt` the f64 packings
they were solved from.

**Checking.** `verify_cert.py` and `verify_cert2.py` (both exact rational, different geometry; described in #375) pass on all
three; minimum certified clearance about 1e-20 (pairs) and 5e-21 (walls).

**Local optimality (numerical evidence, not interval proofs).** Each S is an 80-digit KKT point with λ ≥ 0, reduced Hessian
PSD modulo exact flat motions (266: 94, 270: 28, 272: 40), and jammed in every corner–corner branch (first-order MILP).

**Not done.** No closed forms; no claim the bounds are optimal; global search near these n is far from exhausted (most
perturbation outcomes near these records are minima seen once).

**Lineage and credit.** 266 descends from David Ellsworth's 2024 record; 270 from Francisco Couzo's 27 September record; 272
from the earlier 272 packing (Cleemann; Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev's s(210) conversion; David Ellsworth; refined by
Tej Stead, June 2026), not from Couzo's current record.  The optimizer (squeeze and sequential-LP descent, `s12/search/packer/`)
is in the same repository.
Register data: CC BY 4.0, Joshua Levy, the squares project.

**AI assistance.** The optimizer, solver, verifiers and this search were written and run with Claude (Anthropic) as a coding
and research agent, directed and reviewed by me.
